options.name: label
options.description: Visible label and accessible name of the list.

options.name: upload
options.type: (file: File, context: { signal: AbortSignal; onProgress: (loaded: number, total?: number) => void; attempt: number; id: string }) => Promise<unknown>
options.description: Transport: performs one attempt. Resolve on success (the value becomes item.response), reject on failure, honour signal.

options.name: preview
options.description: Image previews via object URLs for image/* files (needs img-src blob:).

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Map a rejection to a user-facing message. Default: generic localized message.

options.name: icons
options.type: Partial<{ file: IconRef; cancel: IconRef; retry: IconRef; remove: IconRef }>

options.name: concurrency
options.description: Uploads running at the same time (1..16).

options.name: retries
options.description: Automatic retries after a failed attempt (0..10).

options.name: retryDelay
options.description: Delay before the first automatic retry in ms (0..60000); doubles for each further retry.

options.name: autoStart
options.description: Start uploading as soon as files are added; when false, call start().

properties.name: items
properties.description: Snapshots of all items in queue order.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancel a queued or uploading item (aborts its signal).

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Queue a failed or cancelled item again.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Remove an item (aborts it; revokes its preview URL).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Abort all uploads, revoke preview URLs, remove rendering. Late results are ignored.

events.name: aui-change
events.detail: { items: readonly UploadItem[]; reason: 'added' | 'started' | 'succeeded' | 'failed' | 'cancelled' | 'retried' | 'removed'; item: UploadItem | null }
events.description: Items were added or removed, or an item changed status (not emitted for progress).

events.name: aui-complete
events.detail: { succeeded: number; failed: number; cancelled: number }
events.description: Nothing is queued or uploading any more (once per batch).

cssClasses.name: aui-upload-queue__summary
cssClasses.description: "{done} of {total} uploaded" or the empty text.
